newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat drops further on fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat drops further on fund selling.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures dropped to the day's lows in late dealings on fund selling with new crop July in fast trading, traders said.
Griffin Trading and Merrill Lynch Futures were the key sellers in the waning 15 minutes of trade, traders said.
Forecasts for rains in the U.S. Great Plains, a collapse in soybean and corn futures plus overall good conditions in the soft red winter wheat growing region combined to pummel the market, they said.
At 1310 CDT, CBOT soft red winter wheat was three to 14-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with July down 14-1/4 at $3.80-1/2.
